target.nozzle.measured_on: stock nozzle of most printers: a placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project in gate/project.json "targets"
target.nozzle.description: nozzle diameter of the .3mf project a part is judged for; a part placed in two projects is judged for each

target.line_width.measured_on: stock outer-wall line of a 0.4 nozzle: a placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project (one project runs 0.62 on a 0.6 nozzle)
target.line_width.description: outer-wall line width of the .3mf project a part is judged for; two lines are the floor of every wall

target.material.measured_on: placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project
target.material.description: filament of the .3mf project a part is judged for; a fit measured in one material is not measured in another

target.layer_height.measured_on: stock layer of a 0.4 nozzle: a placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project
target.layer_height.description: layer height of the .3mf project a part is judged for; a height along the print axis is printed in whole layers

target.initial_layer_print_height.measured_on: stock first layer of many process presets: a placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project
target.initial_layer_print_height.description: first layer height of the .3mf project (the slicer's key initial_layer_print_height): the layers are counted from it, so with a first layer of 0.2 and layers of 0.3 a face prints at 0.2, 0.5, 0.8, ...

target.xy_hole_compensation.measured_on: stock value of most process presets: a placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project
target.xy_hole_compensation.description: slicer X-Y hole compensation of the .3mf project: every hole is cut wider by this much per side; a hole fit measured with one value is not measured with another

target.xy_contour_compensation.measured_on: stock value of most process presets: a placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project
target.xy_contour_compensation.description: slicer X-Y contour compensation of the .3mf project: every outer contour moves by this much per side

target.elefant_foot_compensation.measured_on: stock value of many process presets: a placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project
target.elefant_foot_compensation.description: slicer elephant foot compensation of the .3mf project (the slicer spells the key elefant_foot_compensation): it moves the first layers of every bed face

target.wall_generator.measured_on: stock value of most process presets: a placeholder; the real value is declared per .3mf project
target.wall_generator.description: wall generator of the .3mf project (classic or arachne): a thin wall and a small hole print at another size under the other one

target.fit_settings.default: nozzle_diameter line_width layer_height initial_layer_print_height xy_hole_compensation xy_contour_compensation elefant_foot_compensation wall_generator
target.fit_settings.measured_on: decided: the slicer settings that move the size of a printed hole, pin or step
target.fit_settings.description: the slicer settings every fit is measured under, by their keys in the project settings of the .3mf, separated by spaces. project.settings_match compares each one, the value every object prints with (its own override, else the global value), with the declared target; the .3mf writer does not change one unasked. In the declared target nozzle_diameter is "nozzle"; every other key keeps its name. An object that is meant to print with another value is declared under "objects" of the target
